description_en: Applies for a roaming join permission
kebab_example: aliyun linkwan apply-roaming-join-permission --freq-band-plan-group-id 102 --class-mode A --join-permission-name '泛在凭证1' --api-version 2019-03-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ApplyRoamingJoinPermission

parameters.help_en:
The frequency band ID used by the roaming join permission. Valid values:

102: CN470 different frequency.
101: CN470 same frequency.
201: AS923 same frequency
parameters.help_zh:
泛在凭证所采用的频段ID。取值：

102：CN470异频。
101：CN470同频。
201：AS923同频
parameters.name: freq_band_plan_group_id

parameters.help_en: The LoRaWAN Class mode used by the roaming join permission. Valid values: A, B, C
parameters.help_zh: 泛在凭证所采用的LoRaWAN Class模式。取值：A、B、C
parameters.name: class_mode

parameters.help_en: The name of the roaming join permission. The name can contain Chinese characters, letters, digits, and underscores (_). The name must be 4 to 30 characters in length. Each Chinese character counts as two characters
parameters.help_zh: 泛在凭证名称，支持中文、英文字母、数字和下划线（_），长度限制4～30个字符，一个中文占两个字符
parameters.name: join_permission_name

parameters.help_en: The receive window delay for Class A. Valid values: 1s to 15s
parameters.help_zh: Class A的接收窗口延迟时间，取值范围1s~15s
parameters.name: rx_delay

parameters.help_en: The expected downlink data rate when ClassMode is set to B. Valid values: 0 to 5
parameters.help_zh: 当ClassMode取值为B时，设置期望下行速率，取值范围0~5
parameters.name: data_rate

Data.description_en: The ID of the roaming join permission

RequestId.description_en: The unique identifier generated by Alibaba Cloud for the request
RequestId.description_zh: 阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the call was successful. Valid values:

true: The call was successful.
false: The call failed
Success.description_zh:
是否调用成功。返回值：

true：调用成功。
** false**：调用失败
